ai_summary: This document is a routine compliance filing from Alankit Limited to the stock exchanges, confirming adherence to SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. It certifies that physical share certificates submitted for dematerialization were properly processed—listed, mutilated, cancelled, and updated in the depository's records. This confirms sound regulatory compliance regarding share dematerialization with no material impacts or red flags identified.
